title: Gully's chair, pulled up
logline: Three chairs on the dock now: the lawn chair, the folding one with the green coat, and a shop stool Gully has carried out, sitting on it heavy with a can, from the side. The three of them, at last, in one page, and Wood is the coat.

panels.composition: On the dock: an old lawn chair, a folding chair with a green coat over it, and a shop stool with a heavy gray man sitting on it holding a can, a woman in the lawn chair from the side, late sun.

characters.pose: on the stool, from the side
in the lawn chair, from the side
